title: 7S.3 fixed-frame OBJECT transaction checkpoint fast slice
mode: Local implementation slice with generated in-memory controls
scope: Avoid comprehensive writer-ledger snapshots for audited fixed, single-frame OBJECT callbacks.
Preserve full rollback for custom-class-associated handles and caller mutation restoration where applicable.
Verify post-frame receipt-failure rollback with existing fast selectors only.

behavior: Introduces writeFixedObjectFrameTransaction using the bounded dwgWriter15 entity-frame checkpoint for the audited fixed one-frame routes.
Falls back to writeObjectTransaction when the explicit object handle is associated with a custom DWG class instance.
Snapshots and restores IMAGEDEF caller-owned table state on failure and remembers successful mutation for an enclosing caller transaction.

Routes DICTIONARY, XRECORD, and fixed-type BLOCKREPRESENTATIONDATA through the bounded path after auditing their encoders: reference/EED work is local to frame emission, and none adds a deferred object/GROUP/style/class ledger entry.
Retains existing GROUP, MLineStyle, custom-class-marking, compound entity, and public transaction paths on comprehensive checkpoints.
testChanges: Extends the existing --block-owner-membership-index generated selector to assert zero full checkpoints for placeholder, VBA PROJECT, IMAGEDEF, LAYOUT, DICTIONARY, XRECORD, and BLOCKREPRESENTATIONDATA facade writes; VBA PROJECT, DICTIONARY, XRECORD, and BLOCKREPRESENTATIONDATA cases carry nonempty payloads.

Injects failed last-frame receipts after IMAGEDEF, DICTIONARY, XRECORD, and BLOCKREPRESENTATIONDATA frame emission and asserts byte count, object map, emitted-handle index, and IMAGEDEF caller handle/parentHandle return to pre-call state.

Adds a negative control where an explicit DICTIONARY handle is already associated with a custom class and is then rejected as reserved; asserts exactly one comprehensive checkpoint, proving the fixed-frame helper keeps the class-associated fallback.

diffCheck.command: git diff --check -- src/libdwgr.h src/libdwgr.cpp tests/dwg_local_roundtrip_tests.cpp DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md

limitations: The no-full-checkpoint assertions are deterministic work evidence, not a wall-clock throughput measurement.

This slice covers only placeholder, VBA PROJECT, IMAGEDEF, LAYOUT, DICTIONARY, XRECORD, and BLOCKREPRESENTATIONDATA. Other OBJECT routes retain full checkpoints pending their own side-ledger and rollback audit.
The shared worktree is broadly dirty and repository Git metadata is read-only; the slice is uncommitted.
nextReadinessSlice: Audit remaining writeObjectTransaction OBJECT routes. Keep full fallback for post-frame deferred ledgers, custom class-instance marks, and compound/public transactions until generated rollback controls cover each route.
